works.author: Tosan Garditama
works.comment: 血液检测与健康计划着陆页 Luminous：柔和的浅色底上，检测流程、健康数据与订阅方案层层展开，插画与留白透着医疗的安心感；健康品牌用“一条检测流程 + 一组健康数据”把验血这件事讲得轻松可信。
works.comment_en: Luminous, a blood testing and health program landing page: on a soft light background, the testing flow, health data and subscription plans unfold layer by layer, with illustrations and whitespace that feel reassuringly clinical; one testing flow and one set of health data make blood testing feel easy and credible.
works.title: Luminous — Blood Testing & Health Program Landing Page

works.author: SlabPixel Designer
works.comment: Nexora 的 AI 员工与专家智能体产品页：深色首屏上多个 AI 智能体分工亮相，能力卡片与工作流把“数字员工”讲得具体可感；AI 产品页用“一组智能体角色 + 一条协作流程”把抽象的 Agent 落到真实工作场景里。
works.comment_en: Nexora's AI workforce and specialist agents product page: on a dark hero, multiple AI agents show off their roles, with capability cards and workflows making "digital employees" concrete; one set of agent roles and one collaboration flow ground abstract agents in real work.
works.title: AI Workforce & Specialist Agents (Product Page) - Nexora

works.author: Kris Anfalova
works.comment: 客服 SaaS 网站：浅色界面上工单、聊天与知识库排得干净利落，大号标题配柔和的插画，专业又不冷冰冰；客服产品用“一个对话窗口 + 一组效率数据”把“帮客户解决问题”说得直接可信。
works.comment_en: A customer support SaaS website: tickets, chat and a knowledge base sit neatly on a light interface, with big headlines and soft illustrations that feel professional without being cold; one chat window and one set of efficiency stats make "solving customer problems" direct and credible.
works.title: Website Design — Customer Support SaaS

works.author: Ronas IT | UI/UX Team
works.comment: 移动电商购物车流程：商品、数量、优惠与结算收在几屏手机界面里，步骤清晰、按钮醒目，下单路径一目了然；电商 App 用“一部手机 + 一条结算路径”把加购到付款的每一步都做得顺手。
works.comment_en: A mobile ecommerce shopping cart flow: items, quantities, discounts and checkout fit into a few phone screens, with clear steps and bold buttons making the path to purchase obvious; one phone and one checkout path make every step from cart to payment feel effortless.
works.title: Mobile Ecommerce - Shopping Cart Flow

works.author: Jack R.
works.comment: Fishbowl CRM 库存管理移动 App：库存数量、订单状态与预警收在一部手机里，数字大、状态色分明，仓库盘点一眼看清；库存工具用“一个数字 + 一种状态色”把仓库的进出存讲得明明白白。
works.comment_en: Fishbowl CRM, an inventory management mobile app: stock levels, order status and alerts fit on one phone, with big numbers and clear status colors making stocktaking obvious at a glance; one number and one status color lay out everything coming in and out of the warehouse.
works.title: Fishbowl CRM - Inventory Management Mobile App

works.author: Mahmudul Hasan Manik
works.comment: 远程医疗仪表盘 Shifa：预约、患者数据与医生排班收在一块浅色仪表盘上，图表与日历排得疏密有致；医疗 SaaS 用“一张日历 + 一组患者数据”把诊所的日常运转搬上屏幕。
works.comment_en: Shifa, a telehealth dashboard: appointments, patient data and doctor schedules share a light dashboard, with charts and a calendar spaced just right; one calendar and one set of patient data bring a clinic's daily operations onto the screen.
works.title: Shifa - Telehealth Dashboard UI UX Design

works.author: Md Foysal
works.comment: AI 医疗与患者护理仪表盘 Mediora：患者档案、AI 诊断建议与护理任务排在深色界面上，绿色点缀透着专业与安心；医疗 AI 用“一个患者档案 + 一条 AI 建议”把诊疗辅助讲得像日常护理。
works.comment_en: Mediora, an AI healthcare and patient care dashboard: patient profiles, AI diagnostic suggestions and care tasks sit on a dark interface, with green accents that feel professional and reassuring; one patient profile and one AI suggestion make diagnostic assistance read like everyday care.
works.title: Mediora – AI Healthcare & Patient Care Dashboard UI/UX Design
